heading: EXT. SALT FLAT BURIAL GROUND - AFTERNOON

units.text: EXT. SALT FLAT BURIAL GROUND - AFTERNOON
White earth to the horizon, cracked into plates like old porcelain.
The wind has dropped.
A single rectangular hole waits in the crust, and around it, six figures stand with their hats in their hands as though the heat itself had asked for silence.
SABINA TREVIÑO, 40s, black veil, black gloves, holds a small boy's shoulder.
TOMÁS, 9, stands very straight in a borrowed jacket.
PADRE ELIAS, 70, thin as a fence rail, turns the pages of a prayer book that does not need turning.
OLD JUBAL, the gravedigger, leans on his shovel, crooked and sun-dark.
MARSHAL CORT HALVERSEN, 50s, wears a tin star polished to a mirror.
Last, a little apart, stands REBECCA "BECK" LANE, 30s, in a gray traveling duster, a woman nobody in town has seen before.
The Padre reads.
His voice carries clean across the flat.
Lord, receive thy servant Ramón Treviño, who has walked out of the dust and into thy keeping.
units.name: PADRE ELIAS

units.text: Sabina nods once.
She does not cry.
Her gloved hand tightens on the boy.
Halversen shifts.
He glances at the stranger, then at the coffin on its ropes, then at the stranger again.
She meets his eye with a calm that seems to cost her nothing.
The Padre closes the book.
Jubal spits to one side and takes up the ropes.
He and the Marshal lower the box.
It goes down a little too easily, and it lands with a soft, hollow knock that no one remarks on.
Mamá, is Papá heavy?
units.name: TOMÁS

units.text: Hush, mijo.
units.name: SABINA

units.text: The Marshal drops to one knee at the lip of the grave.
He studies the lid, then the nails, then runs one thumb along the seam.
Jubal. Hand me that shovel.
units.name: MARSHAL HALVERSEN

units.text: Marshal, the man is buried.
units.name: OLD JUBAL

units.text: The man was never in there.
units.name: MARSHAL HALVERSEN

units.text: Silence.
The wind comes back, soft, and rattles the Padre's pages.
Sabina lets go of the boy.
She reaches into her veil and draws out a small revolver with an ivory grip.
Beck's hand disappears into her duster.
Jubal's fingers slide off the shovel.
Ma'am, I'd rather we all just walked home.
units.name: BECK

units.text: So would I, señorita. But he took the gold, and I gave him the box.
units.name: SABINA
